typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BatchCategoryID as integer (),
	BatchID as integer (),
	BLIVCreateDtm as timestamp (),
	BossDataSource as string (),
	BossInitialCatalog as string (),
	BossPassword as string (),
	BossUserName as string (),
	CAEFTSplit_Day1 as integer (),
	CAEFTSplit_Day2 as integer (),
	CAEFTSplit_Day3 as integer (),
	CNT_Extn as string (),
	Continue as boolean (),
	CriticalEventSeverityID as integer (),
	DeleteFilePath as string (),
	EventTypeID as integer (),
	ExtractFileName as string (),
	ExtractFileNameFinal as string (),
	ExtractFileNamePrefix as string (),
	ExtractFilePath as string (),
	FacetsDataSource as string (),
	FacetsPassword as string (),
	FacetsUserID as string (),
	gv_GetCnt as string (),
	InfoEventSeverityID as integer (),
	ModuleID as integer (),
	XML as string ()
}

source(output(
		COUNT as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::gv_GetCnt',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBPSDCNT	source(output(
		COL_XML as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: '[Invoice].[Pr_GenerateXML_Inv_PSD] 	@BatchId = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBTCFileDataBOSS
SRCOLEDBPSDCNT sink(input(
		Column_0 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = COUNT)) ~> FlatFileDestination
SRCOLEDBTCFileDataBOSS derive({Copy of COL_XML} = toString(COL_XML)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		COL_XML as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		COL_XML = {Copy of COL_XML})) ~> DSTFFTCFileXML
